notes: Fixes GET /api/services?category=...&geo=... wrongly returning zero results whenever a Landing Category has no Geo keyword set and the caller still passed ?geo=true or ?geo=false - a category with no geo/non-geo split now correctly ignores the geo parameter entirely and returns its full result either way, instead of being filtered down to nothing. Also fixes GET /api/services/{id} wrongly 404ing for real, available catalog services that just aren't wired up to a Landing Category yet. Requires 'Update database' for two new tables (catalog_services, landing_service_categories) if not already applied.
